# gql_dio_link

**Tag**: graphql, gql, gql-link, dio, web, serialization, networking

## 简介

Similar to gql_http_link, gql_dio_link is a GQL Terminating Link to execute requests via Dio using JSON

## 官网

- 源码仓库: https://github.com/gql-dart/gql
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/gql_dio_link
